title: On theCUBE Pod: Machine identities pose cybersecurity threat - SiliconANGLE
summary: Nvidia's introduction of open-source tools at their GTC event has raised cybersecurity concerns due to the proliferation of machine identities, which are now outnumbering human identities and are being used in potentially malicious ways.
sentiment_reason: The introduction of these tools has increased the surface area for attacks and the number of machine identities, causing heightened concern among cybersecurity experts about the difficulty of tracking and securing these identities.
